title: Influence bound for bounded-width formulas
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and choose either the AND gate or the OR gate. If the chosen gate has a formula representation of width at most $w$—a CNF representation for AND or a DNF representation for OR—then the total influence of $f$ is at most $2w$.
